sloka: अभ्युत्थानं त्वमद्यैव कृष्णपक्षचतुर्दशीम्।कृत्वा निर्याह्यमावास्यां विजयाय बलैर्वृतः ।। ६.९३.६५ ।।
transliteration: abhyutthānaṁ tvamadyaiva kṛṣṇapakṣacaturdaśīm।kṛtvā niryāhyamāvāsyāṁ vijayāya balairvṛtaḥ ।। 6.93.65 ।।

translations.english: "O King! Mythili is endowed with charm. Your anger may be exhibited on Rama in battle (not Sita)'."
